feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1069 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: California Meal & Rest Break Premium Checker — free timecard audit
entry.summary: Free California meal and rest break premium pay checker for restaurants, retail and any hourly employer. Paste timecards, find late, short and missed meal periods and rest break shortfalls, and total the one-hour premium owed per workday. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Courier Van Route Profit Calculator — true profit per route, per hour and per stop
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent delivery van contractors. Enter route pay, stops, packages, miles, fuel, van payment, insurance and tax set-aside; it shows true profit per route, per hour and per stop, break-even stops, the lowest route pay that hits your hourly target, and compares two route offers. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: FLSA Regular-Rate Overtime Audit — free payroll check
entry.summary: Free FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime audit for restaurants, retailers, staffing agencies and bookkeepers. Paste payroll rows, see the regular rate with bonuses and shift differentials, the half-time premium owed, back pay and lookback exposure. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Amusement Route Location Calculator — is each arcade, pool table or claw machine location worth the drive?
entry.summary: Free calculator for coin-op route operators. Enter each location's weekly take, commission, visits and miles; it shows profit per route hour, the weekly take you need, and the highest commission you can pay and still earn your target. Private, in your browser.

entry.title: Barbershop Chair Profit Calculator — Haircut Price, Booth Rent vs Commission
